name: Carmilla
source:
Charming and adorable beyond words, this vampire is a prone victim of baseless flattery. Harmless as she may come across, Carmilla is second to none when it comes to the magic of seduction.

[From [url=https://nifty-visuals.itch.io/witches-x-warlocks]itch.io[/url]]
